transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on finalizing the Ash Harbor callback package for Mara Quill. We've got Studio 4 booked for June 18, 9 AM to 1 PM, with the North Wall excerpt, an optional movement exercise, and recorded auditions for internal review. I need each of your sign-offs — counsel, stunt, dialect, and studio scheduling — before I issue the call sheet. What concerns or updates do you have?
